custom_domain.title: Custom domain
custom_domain.description: Show this chat at an address of your own, such as help.yourshop.com.
custom_domain.saved: Domain saved. We are checking it now.
custom_domain.off_body: Ask your administrator to turn on custom domains for this server.
custom_domain.active_body: Your chat is live at this domain.
custom_domain.waiting_body: Add the record below. We check the domain every few minutes, and it can take up to an hour after you add the record.
custom_domain.dns_title: Add this record at your domain provider

check.no_certificate: Your domain points here, but this server has no certificate for it yet. Ask your administrator to set up certificates for custom domains.
check.points_elsewhere: Your domain answers, but not from this server. Check that the record points to {target}.
check.not_reached: We cannot reach your domain yet. Check that the record points to {target}, then wait a few minutes.
check.private_address: Your domain points to a private network address. Point it to {target}.
